hypothesis: Extreme realized funding that is not confirmed by immediately preceding price action identifies crowded positioning vulnerable to short-horizon reversal.

data.funding_source: Binance USD-M public GET /fapi/v1/fundingRate, snapshotted by shard artifacts
data.validation: 2025-2026 SEEN validation; not read in this TRAIN run
data.universe: all symbols present in frozen price artifacts with non-empty funding history

signal.decision_time: funding settlement timestamp after the realized funding rate is known
signal.entry: first 15m OPEN strictly after funding timestamp (+15m for on-grid settlements)
signal.funding_history: prior 90 calendar days only; current event excluded from trailing quantile
signal.side: opposite funding sign: positive funding => SHORT; negative funding => LONG

price_failure_modes.H4_STALL: funding_sign * prior 4h close-to-close move / prior ATR14_1h <= 0.5

signal.requirement: funding extreme AND selected price-failure mode

execution.canonical_chronology: AGENTS.md section 11; official Binance 1m for same-parent-bar ambiguity
execution.funding_pnl: excluded in V1 on purpose; funding is signal only. If signal edge survives, actual funding cashflows will be modeled in a new frozen generation.

portfolio.priority: entry_time asc, abs(funding_rate) desc, funding_tail_strength desc, symbol asc

gates: at least 3/4 calendar years positive at 20bp
at least one adjacent grid configuration PF20 > 1.03 and ret20 > 0
selection.ranking: ret20 desc, MDD20 asc, PF40 desc, executable N desc
selection.next_if_pass: freeze stable TRAIN region, then add realized funding PnL in a new generation before opening validation
